title: A formal boundary between living and nonliving chemical organization
description:
Living organization requires the joint retention of compartment, maintenance, heritable continuation and regulated resource exchange. Maria Smith develops the complete Smithian Fold Theory construction linking living organization, the chemical boundary, autocatalytic closure and maintenance.

The paper gives the eight-coordinate grammar, exhaustive 256-form classification for each obligation, unique-survivor proof, original finite-successor closure argument and full sealed source-comparison procedure. Includes 1,024 candidate decisions, 475 distinct empty-axiom audited Lean declarations, pinned V3/V4 sources and retained complete-return verification.

Correspondence: Maria.smith.sftoe@gmail.com. Join the SFT community: Discord invitation.
